@{author}, this repository requires a maintainer's vouch before accepting a PR
from a new external contributor.

Open a [Contribution interest issue](https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/issues/new?template=contribution.yml)
with your proposed work, scope, and validation plan. Follow the
[contribution guide](https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/blob/{default_branch}/CONTRIBUTING.rst)
and wait for the maintainer's vouch to appear in `VOUCHED.td` on the default
branch before reopening this PR. Do not add yourself to that file in this PR.

Already vouched contributors and collaborators with write access do not need
another issue. If that applies to you, ask a maintainer to inspect the Vouch
workflow. Bug reports and
questions are welcome without a vouch.
